source.notes: Top-level request parameters listed on the provider's chat API reference (accessed 2026-10-17). Nested shapes are not modelled. reasoning_effort accepts only none and high (maps to Cohere thinking off/on); low and medium "not supported at this time". Cohere-native params (connectors, documents, citation_options, ...) are not available through this API. System prompts are sent with the developer role. tools[].function.strict supported. Structured output: response_format type json_object plus a schema. The native v2 Chat API
